item.title: Craig Mazin is working on a Baldur’s Gate 3 TV show
item.description: Warner Bros. Discovery’s HBO is bringing a new TV series to life based on the video game franchise Baldur’s Gate, which is set with the Forgotten Realms of Dungeons & Dragons. item.description: Science teacher Ryland Grace (Ryan Gosling) wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. item.title: The Adventures of Cliff Booth – Watch Brad Pitt in the teaser for the film directed by David Fincher and written by Quentin Tarantino

item.title: Review: Wuthering Heights – “Jacob and Margot smoulder together on screen”
